data.name: Order of the Lion
data.description: An order of the lion cavalier can make Knowledge (nobility) skill checks untrained. If she has ranks in the skill, she receives a bonus on the check equal to 1/2 her cavalier level (minimum +1) as long as the check involves her sovereign.
